map.水分重=100−92=8 g；湿基含水率=8/100×100=8.00%；干基含: Water weight=100−92=8 g; wet-basis moisture=8/100×100=8.00%; dry-basis moisture=8/92×100≈8.70%; dry-basis ratio=92.00%. 8% falls within the standard moisture range (4%–10%). Formula: wet basis = water/wet weight, dry basis = water/dry weight. [SRC]
map.湿基 4%–10% 为『标准含水率范围』；<4% 偏干、≤12% 偏高、>12%: Wet basis 4%–10% is the 'standard moisture range'; <4% is on the dry side, ≤12% is on the high side, >12% is too high. The dry basis is used for laboratory oven-dry conversions and must not be confused with the wet basis.
